angle: Late big chance under a Chaos Index spike — Kwabena Asante denied from 1.0 m as Harbourside hunt a comeback while chaos reads 96.

explanation.why_it_matters: A Chaos Index spike to 96 — driven by turnovers (z 1.91) and increased shots — produced a 0.489 xG, 1.0 m opportunity for Kwabena Asante that was saved. With Northbridge controlling 0.66 share, the stop preserved a 3–1 lead and denied Harbourside a momentum-shifting route back into the game.

en.headline: Asante's late chance saved
en.body: Kwabena Asante almost sparked a comeback but his close-range effort was saved. Harbourside still trail and need a lift.

it.headline: Parata sulla chance tardiva di Asante
it.body: Kwabena Asante ha quasi riaperto la partita, ma il suo tentativo ravvicinato è stato parato. Harbourside resta in svantaggio e ha bisogno di una scossa.

ja.headline: Asanteの終盤の決定機はセーブされる
ja.body: Kwabena Asanteはほぼ逆転のきっかけを作ったが、至近距離からのシュートはセーブされた。Harboursideは依然としてリードを許しており、盛り返しが必要だ。

en.headline: Chaos spike produces high xG chance
en.body: Chaos Index 96 drove a 0.489 xG opportunity from inside the box. Northbridge control_share 0.66 limited follow-up danger; Asante's DVA -0.255 shows a slightly suboptimal decision compared with the best option.

it.headline: Picco di Chaos genera un'occasione ad alto xG
it.body: Chaos Index 96 ha creato un'opportunità da 0.489 xG dall'interno dell'area. Il control_share di Northbridge 0.66 ha limitato il pericolo sui rimbalzi; la DVA di Asante -0.255 indica una scelta leggermente subottimale rispetto alla migliore opzione.

ja.headline: カオスの急騰が高xGの決定機を生む
ja.body: Chaos Index 96がボックス内から0.489のxG機会を生んだ。Northbridgeのcontrol_share 0.66は続く危険を抑制し、AsanteのDVA -0.255は最良の選択肢と比べてやや最適でない判断を示している。

en.headline: Big chance inside the box
en.body: Inside the box, centrally, Kwabena Asante shoots from about 1.0 m. The shot is saved. The stop keeps the score at Northbridge 3, Harbourside 1 during a Chaos Index spike.

it.headline: Grande occasione in area
it.body: In area, al centro, Kwabena Asante tira da circa 1.0 m. Il tiro viene parato. La parata mantiene il punteggio sul Northbridge 3, Harbourside 1 durante un picco del Chaos Index.

ja.headline: ボックス内の大きな決定機
ja.body: ボックス内、中央付近でKwabena Asanteが約1.0 mからシュートを打ちます。シュートはセーブされます。このセーブでスコアはNorthbridge 3、Harbourside 1のまま、Chaos Indexの急騰中です。

en.headline: Asante denied at point-blank range
en.body: Kwabena Asante, with 10 shots and 1.42 xg in the match, got a 1.0 m chance but was saved. His DVA sits at -0.255 for the game.

it.headline: Asante fermato a distanza ravvicinata
it.body: Kwabena Asante, con 10 tiri e 1.42 xg nella partita, ha avuto un'occasione da 1.0 m ma è stato parato. La sua DVA è -0.255 per la partita.

ja.headline: Asanteが至近距離で阻まれる
ja.body: Kwabena Asanteはこの試合でシュート10本、1.42 xgを記録し、1.0 mのチャンスを得たがセーブされた。彼のDVAは試合通算で-0.255だ。
